title: EFCC Raid at Mama Put

scenes.speaker: Town Crier
scenes.dialogue: EFCC don land! Everybody freeze! Drop your phone, drop your spoon!
scenes.image_keyword: man bursting into buka shouting, hands up, customers frozen mid-eat
scenes.text: EFCC don land! Everybody freeze! Drop your phone, drop your spoon!

scenes.speaker: Mama Nkechi
scenes.dialogue: Eh? Which kain EFCC? I never even cook today meat finish!
scenes.image_keyword: mama nkechi holding giant wooden spoon, wide eyes, steam rising from pots
scenes.text: Eh? Which kain EFCC? I never even cook today meat finish!

scenes.speaker: Bros J
scenes.dialogue: Officer sir, I just dey wash hand for here. No be me order goat meat.
scenes.caption_text: BROS J: NA HAND I DEY WASH 🤷🏾‍♂️
scenes.image_keyword: man in crisp suit at sink, soap on elbows, goat meat visible on table behind him
scenes.text: Officer sir, I just dey wash hand for here. No be me order goat meat.

scenes.speaker: Aunty Risi
scenes.dialogue: Me? I come buy pure water. The amala na for my neighbor pikin.
scenes.image_keyword: woman with colorful wig, clutching pure water sachet, three wraps of amala hidden in bag
scenes.text: Me? I come buy pure water. The amala na for my neighbor pikin.

scenes.speaker: Pastor Tunde
scenes.dialogue: I dey fast o! This ewedu na holy water for deliverance.
scenes.image_keyword: pastor in collar, holding bowl of ewedu like chalice, serious face
scenes.text: I dey fast o! This ewedu na holy water for deliverance.

scenes.speaker: Student Boy
scenes.dialogue: Sir, I be 100 level. My pocket money no reach EFCC level.
scenes.image_keyword: thin student in backpack, empty plate, counting 50 naira notes on table
scenes.text: Sir, I be 100 level. My pocket money no reach EFCC level.

scenes.speaker: Area Boy
scenes.dialogue: Chairman, I dey provide security. Na me dey watch the gate.
scenes.image_keyword: muscular guy in singlet, leaning on wall, chewing toothpick, fake ID card on chest
scenes.text: Chairman, I dey provide security. Na me dey watch the gate.

scenes.speaker: Officer Chidi
scenes.dialogue: Everybody shut up! I dey count three. One... two...
scenes.image_keyword: man in ill-fitting jacket, fake EFCC badge, pointing finger, sweat on forehead
scenes.text: Everybody shut up! I dey count three. One... two...

scenes.speaker: Mama Nkechi
scenes.dialogue: Chidi! You never pay for last week semo! Carry your badge comot!
scenes.image_keyword: mama nkechi slapping fake badge off chest, other hand on hip, officer recoiling
scenes.text: Chidi! You never pay for last week semo! Carry your badge comot!

scenes.speaker: Officer Chidi
scenes.dialogue: Mama Nkechi, na me be your brother! I come collect my change!
scenes.image_keyword: officer removing fake badge, revealing plain shirt underneath, looking ashamed
scenes.text: Mama Nkechi, na me be your brother! I come collect my change!

scenes.speaker: Bros J
scenes.dialogue: So we dey panic for ordinary change? Bros, you wicked!
scenes.image_keyword: suit guy adjusting tie, pointing at officer, others gathering behind him
scenes.text: So we dey panic for ordinary change? Bros, you wicked!

scenes.speaker: Aunty Risi
scenes.dialogue: My wig don shift! You go pay for styling!
scenes.image_keyword: woman fixing displaced wig angrily, holding officer's collar
scenes.text: My wig don shift! You go pay for styling!

scenes.speaker: Pastor Tunde
scenes.dialogue: The devil is a liar! But Chidi, return the tithe you chop.
scenes.image_keyword: pastor laying hands on officer's head, congregation style, officer kneeling
scenes.text: The devil is a liar! But Chidi, return the tithe you chop.

scenes.speaker: Area Boy
scenes.dialogue: Chairman, since you be family, dash us one round amala.
scenes.image_keyword: area boy rallying crowd, everyone chanting 'amala! amala!' officer sweating
scenes.text: Chairman, since you be family, dash us one round amala.

scenes.speaker: Real EFCC (voice)
scenes.dialogue: *Phone rings* "Chidi, where you dey? Office dey find you."
scenes.image_keyword: officer's phone screen showing 'BOSS EFCC' caller ID, everyone laughing, freeze frame
scenes.text: *Phone rings* "Chidi, where you dey? Office dey find you."

caption: When fake EFCC enter buka but na Mama Nkechi pikin 😂 Lagos no dey carry last! Tag who go panic first.
